system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi. I need to change my address. I want my user address and all my order addresses to be updated to 101 Highway, New York, 10001. Can you do that for me?

I can help — first I need to verify your identity. Please provide EITHER:
- your email address, OR
- your first name, last name, and zip code.

Also I want to confirm the new address you want applied. From your message I understand:
- Address1: 101 Highway
- Address2: (none)
- City: New York
- State: NY
- Country: USA
- Zip: 10001

Please confirm that is correct (or tell me any corrections), and provide your email OR name + zip so I can look up your account. Note: I can update your account's default address and any pending orders’ shipping addresses. I cannot change the shipping address on orders that are already processed or delivered — I will list which orders can be updated before making any changes and ask you to confirm. Do you want me to proceed once I look up your account?

Yes, that address is correct.

My name is Ethan Garcia and my zip code is 80280.

Please proceed.

Thanks — I tried to look up your account by name and zip but the lookup failed due to a system error. I can either try the lookup again now or you can give me your email address (which will let me locate your account right away). Which would you prefer?

Once I can locate your account I will:
- list your default address and all orders, showing which orders can have the shipping address updated (only pending orders can be changed) and which cannot (processed/delivered),
- then, if you confirm, update your default address and the shipping address on all pending orders to:
  - Address1: 101 Highway
  - Address2: (none)
  - City: New York
  - State: NY
  - Country: USA
  - Zip: 10001

Please reply with “retry” to let me try the name+zip lookup again, or provide your email address.

Sorry — the account lookup by name+zip failed again due to a system error. I can’t proceed without locating your user id. You have two options:

1) Provide your email address now so I can locate your account and continue; or
2) I can transfer you to a human agent to complete this (I’ll transfer your chat with a short summary if you choose this).

Quick reminder of the address you confirmed:
- Address1: 101 Highway
- Address2: (none)
- City: New York
- State: NY
- Country: USA
- Zip: 10001

Also note I can update your default account address and the shipping address on pending orders only (processed/delivered orders cannot be changed). Once I locate your account I will list which orders can be updated and ask for your explicit yes before making any changes.

Which would you like to do?
I’d rather not give my email. Please transfer me to a human agent.
